notes: First public Linux x64 preview with GitHub Copilot subscription support; telemetry and remote diagnostic uploads are disabled.
Installs as codex. Internal package version matches the executable so normal background-server launch works.
macOS, Windows and Linux ARM64 packages have not been published. Live account login/inference and the full workspace test suite have not been completed.

assets.name: zai-codex for Linux x64
assets.installNotes: Linux x64, glibc 2.39+, OpenSSL 3, libcap2, zlib, zstd and libtinfo6. Python 3.10+ is required for the installer. Run codex after installation. Unsigned preview; keep the complete bundle together. Alpine/musl is unsupported.
